abilities.name: Dream Nail
abilities.note: Required to fight Elder Hu's spirit; collects Essence upon boss defeat

abilities.name: Silk
abilities.note: Resource represented as a spool below health indicator; consumed by special abilities; filled by hitting enemies with the Needle (2 laces per hit)

abilities.name: Bind
abilities.note: A form of Focus ability that consumes Silk thread

abilities.name: Needle
abilities.note: Hornet's main weapon; used to slash, block, dash-stab, bounce above enemies, deal greater damage with abilities, or used as a grappling hook

abilities.name: Tools
abilities.note: Special items equipped on a Crest with limited slots; usable as throwing weapons or defensive aids without costing Silk; changed at a Bench like Charms

abilities.name: Crest
abilities.note: Equipment interface with limited slots used to equip Tools; changed at a Bench

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Spirit of a travelling sage; fought at his memorial above the gates to City of Tears after acquiring Dream Nail. Attacks: Ring Slam (row of rings slammed to ground with safe gaps), Ring Curtain (pairs of rings from edges moving to centre), Teleport. Drops 100 Essence.

objectives.name: Acquire the Dream Nail
objectives.hopDescription: Obtain the Dream Nail key item to unlock access to Elder Hu's spirit

objectives.name: Fight Elder Hu at his memorial
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to Elder Hu's memorial above the gates to the City of Tears and engage his spirit using the Dream Nail

objectives.name: Collect Essence from Elder Hu
